en: Sepia-toned street scene showing an older man leaning against the wall of a stucco building on a cobblestone street. Above him is an ornate framed religious niche or shrine mounted on the façade, with flowers at a nearby open window. Other shuttered windows and an arched passageway are visible in the background, where a couple of people sit on the ground. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century European town. Printed captions appear at the bottom margin.
